resources.string: Keep this screen open while the files are copied. Cloud-only files may need time to download.
Share the actual photos or videos again, rather than a link. Check your internet connection and available phone storage.

Backup is queued. Open Photos App to see progress. Original dates are used when available; otherwise the date shared is used. You can edit the date in Details.
Files received so far are saved on this device. Open Photos App and tap Back up now to retry backup.
Original date unavailable. Using the date shared; you can edit it.

Choose a valid date and time in this time zone.
This changes the timeline in Photos App and its cloud backup. The original file stays unchanged.
